scope: Read-only source audit after gamma ABI confirmation; no new app/model/target/protected-media execution

paths.finding: Two-element gamma request is ignored by installedbinary. Workingbuffer and linear flag/comment misdescribe the transfer. Area-average operates on encoded values. Shared by canonical research exports and experimental modelinput.
paths.size: Confirmed encoding on one native-grid scene, exact canonical reproduction on two allowed scenes; fullcorpus and user-visible error magnitude not quantified.

paths.finding: Normalizes uint16 tofloat32 without an additional input transfer transform. Misleading names/flag checks, but the trained R11 sees the same legacycontract at runtime. DRcondition is metadata-derived, not computed from these pixels.
paths.size: No newly demonstrated train/inference mismatch; changing decode underneath R11 would introduce one.

paths.finding: R11 outputs are trained against correctly linearized Fuji targets; display applies sRGB OETF. The input label error does not imply removing this output conversion.

paths.path: rawService.ts decodeNeutralRafInBrowser / useFileDrop / standard recipe shader
paths.finding: Separate8bit default-transfer JPEG path, no two-element gamma request. Therefore not directly this ABI failure. Canvas treats8bitRGB as sRGB; shader WB/LUT operations are display-domain empirical calibration. Any Rec709-vs-sRGB transfer mismatch needs its own test, not a silent globalgamma edit.
paths.size: Unquantified; no app-vs-Fuji recipe scoring in this stage.

paths.finding: Standard native CIRAW JPEG conversion is separate and not subject to the LibRaw-Wasm gamm-array parser. Experimental native WebViews use the same Wasm modelinput path and are affected as above.
Pre-demosaic raw mosaic statistics are not imageData output and do not receive the output gamma curve. Their raw-percentile metadata evidence is unaffected by this gamma-label finding.
paths.size: No change to archived RAWfeature values or selected DRconditioning evidence.

paths.path: training target_tiff.py / saved Fuji reference metrics
paths.finding: Fuji TIFF target decoding/linearization is independent of LibRaw. Existing numerical output evaluations remain recorded evidence; input-physics interpretations need review.
paths.size: No blanket invalidation or rewriting of prior results.

decision: Preserve selectedR11/app and existing flaggedcontainers. Versioned trulylinear research contract and pairedcomparison need separate scope; do not overwrite canonicals, reinterpret old tensors or integrate unqualified WBneutralisation.
